# PRD-OPS-02

**Does every SLO alert the support team when it is at risk, and is the solution in the monitoring it will be run with?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Production entry lens](production.md) 0.1.1 |
| Area | OPS: Run |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `operations.slos.alerting`, `operations.observability` |

## Rule

Every SLO has alerting true; observability has logs, metrics, traces and audit_trail true. A reviewer confirms the dashboards and alerts exist for this version.

## Sources

- Google, Site Reliability Engineering, chapter 32, The Evolving SRE Engagement Model (the Production Readiness Review) (`sre-prr`)
- AWS Well-Architected Framework (`wa-aws`)
